synopsis: Peru's DS 024-2016-EM is a mining occupational safety regulation providing general mining safety rules and a mobile-equipment risk framework [f2132, f2294, f15584]. Chapter 3 reports that no dedicated collision-braking acceptance regime was found in the reviewed material, and the glossary repeats that finding [f2295, f15585]. The corpus therefore identifies a general safety framework but leaves collision-braking acceptance criteria unresolved; the finding is limited to the material reviewed, not proof that no such regime exists [f2294, f2295].

relations.note: Both report no collision-braking acceptance regime found; Chapter 3 specifies reviewed material.
